requires.label: Medically necessary care for non-emergency services
requires.quote: Services and items (other than emergency care) must be medically necessary as determined by the patient’s physician to be eligible for financial assistance.

rules.label: Financial Assistance Program up to 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients will be considered as eligible for financial assistance up to 250% of the federal poverty level (FPL).

rules.label: AGB cap for emergency and medically necessary care
rules.quote: In no event shall the reduced rate charged to patients eligible for financial assistance for emergency care or medically necessary services be greater than the AGB for such services.

rules.label: Gross charge limit for other care
rules.quote: With respect to medical care provided other than emergency care and medically necessary services, patients eligible for financial assistance shall not be charged more than gross charges for such care.

notes: Eligibility for financial assistance is determined by comparison of household income to FPL, with discount based on Amounts Generally Billed (AGB).
AGB is calculated annually using the look-back method per Section 501(r) of the Code and applied by the 45th day after the first day of the fiscal year start.
Patients deemed eligible for financial assistance will not receive future bills for previously provided services based on undiscounted gross charges.
The policy defers to HDC and CICP Operations Manual for screening, application, appeals, and eligibility determinations.
If a patient is not eligible for public programs and lacks insurance, the Self-Pay Discount policy applies.
The policy requires completion of the Financial Assistance Application with all necessary documentation; refusal to complete renders patient ineligible.
HCHD assists patients with applying for Medicaid, HDC, or CICP coverage and expects cooperation in providing documentation.
Financial assistance decisions are approved by Patient Financial Services management team.
Notifications of determination are made per HDC §6.01 and §11.01.
Laminated cards for CICP and HDC eligibility are issued with effective dates, mailed or in person.
Appeals follow HDC Article XI.
HCHD will not bill patient balances to those who qualify for CICP or HDC; balances are adjusted to internal financial assistance program.
HCHD permits public to obtain, in writing and free of charge, the actual AGB percentage and calculation methodology.
HCHD makes reasonable efforts to determine financial assistance eligibility before engaging in extraordinary collection actions (ECAs)
HCHD has a separate Patient Collections Policy consistent with Section 501(r)(6) of the Code, widely publicized and available.
Policy does not discourage seeking emergency care, requires no pre-payment, and prohibits debt collection activities that interfere with medical screening or stabilization under EMTALA.
Policy is widely publicized in communities served consistent with Section 501(r) of the Code and related regulations.
Contact for application or information: Financial Counseling Specialist at Spanish Peaks Regional Health Center, 23500 US Highway 160, Walsenburg CO 81089, 719-738-4544.
Appendix B lists providers delivering emergency or medically necessary care in HCHD facilities, indicating which are covered by this policy.
